_about: Public-domain J. N. Darby (John Nelson Darby, 1800-1882, Plymouth Brethren) for the Word Hoard: the five-volume Synopsis of the Books of the Bible (Morrish, undated), six volumes of the posthumous Notes and Comments on Scripture (1884-1913), and from Internet Archive scans his Toronto lectures on the Second Coming (1863), Studies on Daniel, Analysis of Newman's Apologia (1866), Practical Reflections on the Psalms, Lectures on First John (1882) and Spiritual Songs (1883). No pre-1930 scan of the Collected Writings exists on IA (every copy is a 1962-74 reprint). Dispensationalism's founder; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
